UNDERSTAND YOUR DATA

Database schema

Four related tables. A transparent foundation for every answer.

Revenue = quantity × unit_price, for completed orders only. All amounts are CAD before tax; refunds, discounts, and tax are not modelled.

How the tables connect

customers.id → orders.customer_id

orders.id → order_items.order_id

products.id → order_items.product_id

The dataset is fictional and fixed to January–September 2026.

BUILD & LEARN

Make Querywise your own.

This hosted edition runs a real SQLite database in your browser. The included FastAPI backend adds model-generated SQL through Ollama or Anthropic Claude, and connects to your own read-only data sources.

  1. Download and start the projectdocker compose up --buildOpen http://localhost:8000. Sample mode works immediately.
  2. Choose a modelOpen Settings (gear icon) → AI provider. Paste an Anthropic API key, or install Ollama and run:ollama pull qwen2.5:7bKeys are encrypted in the local app-state database and never shown again in full. Environment variables in .env override saved settings.
  3. Connect your dataSettings → Data sources: add PostgreSQL, SQLite, MySQL, MariaDB, SQL Server, Oracle, Db2, MongoDB, Elasticsearch, Excel/CSV or Parquet. Querywise tests the connection, discovers every table and column, and grounds the AI in that schema.
  4. Ask an open-ended questionThe model receives the discovered schema and your question, never row data. SQL is validated against the source’s tables, then executed read-only. The README explains setup, safeguards, tests, and each connector’s limits.
Download sourceRead the guide ↗
No API key is required for local Ollama. The hosted demo is not connected to a model or your private databases.
LOCAL SETTINGS

Connections & AI

Switching a source tests the connection first, then discovers every table and column. The AI prompt and the table allowlist use that discovered schema.

Add a connection

Secrets are encrypted in the local, git-ignored app-state database and are never returned to the browser. Environment variables override saved values and lock the matching field here. Only the schema and your question are sent to the AI provider, never row data.
